tools.name: discord_application_assets
tools.description: Manage this application's emojis and linked-role metadata schema.

tools.name: discord_application_command
tools.description: List and manage this application's guild-scoped or global slash, user, and message commands.

tools.name: discord_apply_blueprint
tools.description: Idempotently create/update resources from one blueprint without deleting unmanaged resources. Guild settings, role permissions, or overwrites make the plan privileged and require full mode plus dry-run confirmation.

tools.name: discord_audit_log
tools.description: Read Discord audit log entries for the allowed guild.

tools.name: discord_automod
tools.description: List, create, modify, or delete Discord AutoMod rules. Create and modify are privileged; delete retains destructive gating.

tools.name: discord_capabilities
tools.description: Describe or search named Discord operation families and their safety requirements without making a network request.

tools.name: discord_channel_operations
tools.description: Inspect a channel, follow an announcement channel, trigger typing, or set a voice-channel status.

tools.name: discord_current_application
tools.description: Read or modify the current Discord application profile and installation metadata. Modifications are privileged and require the one-time confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_current_bot_profile
tools.description: Read or modify this operator bot's username, avatar, and banner. Modifications are privileged and require the one-time confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a channel. Requires full mode, destructive enablement, and an exact confirmation string.

tools.name: discord_delete_role
tools.description: Delete a role with an exact confirmation string.

tools.name: discord_directory
tools.description: Browse guild channels and roles, search members, or inspect bans with guild allowlist enforcement.

tools.name: discord_dm
tools.description: Use a one-to-one DM only for recipients explicitly listed in DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_IDS. The feature is disabled by default.

tools.name: discord_emoji
tools.description: List, create, modify, or delete guild emojis. Create accepts a Discord data URI in body.image.

tools.name: discord_export_snapshot
tools.description: Export guild metadata, roles, channels, AutoMod, onboarding, and welcome screen for planning or backup.

tools.name: discord_forum_thread
tools.description: Create and manage forum posts and text-channel threads, all archive types, and thread membership.

tools.name: discord_get_guild
tools.description: Read a guild and its approximate member/presence counts.

tools.name: discord_guild_operations
tools.description: Inspect extended guild state and run guarded administration operations such as pruning, incident actions, integrations, and bulk bans.

tools.name: discord_guild_template
tools.description: List, inspect, create, sync, edit, or delete guild templates without creating a new guild.

tools.name: discord_health
tools.description: Validate the active bot runtime or audit the authenticated application's public-release readiness without exposing secrets or owner data.

tools.name: discord_invite
tools.description: List, inspect, create, or delete guild invites with scoped channel verification.

tools.name: discord_known_permissions
tools.description: List permission names accepted by blueprint and overwrite tools.

tools.name: discord_list_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a channel in an allowed guild.

tools.name: discord_member_roles
tools.description: Add and remove multiple roles from a guild member. Role assignment is privileged and requires the one-time confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_members
tools.description: Get one member or list members. Bulk listing may require the Guild Members privileged intent.

tools.name: discord_membership_screening
tools.description: Read or replace the Membership Screening rules shown on Discord's Access page. Updates use Discord's unstable endpoint and require full mode plus the one-time confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_message
tools.description: Inspect, send, edit, delete, bulk delete, crosspost, list pins, pin, or unpin messages in an allowed guild channel.

tools.name: discord_message_search
tools.description: Search indexed messages in an allowed guild. Requires the privileged Message Content intent.

tools.name: discord_moderate_member
tools.description: Modify, timeout, kick, ban, or unban a guild member. Removal actions require exact confirmation.

tools.name: discord_modify_guild
tools.description: Modify guild-level settings. This is privileged and requires full mode plus the exact payload-bound confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_onboarding
tools.description: Get or replace guild onboarding configuration. Replacement is privileged and requires the one-time confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_permission_overwrite
tools.description: List, upsert, or delete a channel permission overwrite using named permissions. Upserts require full mode and a payload-bound dry-run confirmation; deletes retain destructive gating.

tools.name: discord_plan_blueprint
tools.description: Compare a version-1 server blueprint with the live guild and return a non-destructive action plan.

tools.name: discord_poll
tools.description: Create a poll, list voters for one answer, or end a bot-authored poll early.

tools.name: discord_raw_guild_request
tools.description: Advanced escape hatch for Discord REST endpoints not covered above. Routes are restricted to the allowed guild, verified channels, webhooks, invites, stage instances, and this bot's guild commands.

tools.name: discord_reaction
tools.description: Add, inspect, or remove reactions on a guild message, including guarded moderation cleanup.

tools.name: discord_reorder_channels
tools.description: Bulk reorder channels and optionally move them between categories.

tools.name: discord_reorder_roles
tools.description: Bulk reorder roles below the bot's highest role.

tools.name: discord_scheduled_event
tools.description: List and manage guild scheduled events, including subscriber lookup.

tools.name: discord_set_channel_permission
tools.description: Create or replace a role/member permission overwrite. Requires full mode and the exact payload-bound confirmation returned by dry-run.

tools.name: discord_soundboard
tools.description: List, create, edit, delete, or play Discord soundboard sounds with file-size validation.

tools.name: discord_stage_instance
tools.description: Read, start, update, or end the live Stage instance associated with an allowed guild channel.

tools.name: discord_sticker
tools.description: List, inspect, create, edit, or delete guild stickers, including validated multipart uploads.

tools.name: discord_upsert_channel
tools.description: Create or modify any guild channel type. Bodies containing permission_overwrites are privileged and require full mode plus the dry-run confirmation.

tools.name: discord_upsert_role
tools.description: Create or modify a guild role. Changing permissions is privileged and requires full mode plus the dry-run confirmation; role hierarchy still applies.

tools.name: discord_voice_member
tools.description: Inspect or change a guild member's voice placement, server mute, or server deaf state.

tools.name: discord_webhook
tools.description: Manage guild-owned webhooks and execute one without returning its token or URL. Lifecycle changes are privileged; deletion retains destructive gating.

tools.name: discord_welcome_screen
tools.description: Get or modify the Community welcome screen.

tools.name: discord_widget
tools.description: Read or modify the public guild widget and return a widget image URL without downloading binary data.
